settings.name: SITE_DOMAIN
settings.description: The domain this server lives at, like hack.example.com. Unset, the server starts in setup mode and asks for one.

settings.name: CONTENT_HOST
settings.description: The separate hostname sites are served from, so pages never share an origin with the dashboard.

settings.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
settings.description: The server's own address, used in emails and sign-in redirects. install.sh sets it to https://<SITE_DOMAIN>.

settings.name: PORT
settings.description: The port the server listens on.

settings.name: BIND_ADDR
settings.description: The interface the server listens on, like 127.0.0.1 behind a proxy. Empty listens on all.

settings.name: DEPLOY_SCRIPT
settings.description: A script run after each site goes live. Empty runs nothing.

settings.name: PERSON_HOSTS
settings.description: Each account at its own address, <handle>.<SITE_DOMAIN>. canonical makes it the address handed out.

settings.name: SITE_HOSTS
settings.description: Each site at its own address, <site>.<handle>.<SITE_DOMAIN>. Needs PERSON_HOSTS.

settings.name: SITE_BASE_DOMAIN
settings.description: The domain people's and sites' addresses live under, when not SITE_DOMAIN itself. The app stays on SITE_DOMAIN.

settings.name: SITE_BASE_MOVE
settings.description: How far addresses have moved from SITE_DOMAIN to SITE_BASE_DOMAIN: both answer (serve), the new ones are handed out (canonical), old ones redirect (redirect: 302, permanent: 301).

settings.name: SETUP_PASSWORD
settings.description: The password a box in setup mode asks for. install.sh generates it.

settings.name: SETUP_PUBLIC_API
settings.description: Where a box in setup mode claims a free hostname from.

settings.name: OPENAI_APPS_CHALLENGE
settings.description: The OpenAI plugin portal's domain-verification token. Unset: not served.

settings.name: SIGNIN_CODE_TTL_MINUTES
settings.description: How long an emailed sign-in code (and link) or email-change code works.

settings.name: MAX_KEYS_PER_ACCOUNT
settings.description: API keys one account may create from the Keys panel.

settings.name: KEY_IDLE_EXPIRY_DAYS
settings.description: An API key unused this long stops working (counted from its last use, or its creation). 0: keys work until revoked.

settings.name: HANDLE_RENAME_EVERY_DAYS
settings.description: Once something is published, how often an account may change its handle.

settings.name: EMAIL_CHANGE_UNDO_DAYS
settings.description: How long the undo link sent to the old address after a sign-in email change works.

settings.name: VISITOR_SESSION_DAYS
settings.description: How long a visitor stays signed in on a site's own address, however active.

settings.name: VISITOR_SESSION_IDLE_DAYS
settings.description: How long a visitor sign-in lasts unused. Not longer than VISITOR_SESSION_DAYS.

settings.name: OAUTH_ACCESS_TTL_MINUTES
settings.description: How long an AI app's access token works before it refreshes.

settings.name: OAUTH_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS
settings.description: How long an AI app stays connected without being used.

settings.name: OAUTH_UNUSED_CLIENT_DAYS
settings.description: An AI app registration that never connected, or went unused, is removed after this many days.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_SIGNIN_IP
settings.description: Sign-in and email-change requests per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_SIGNIN_EMAIL
settings.description: Sign-in codes sent to one email address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_VISITOR_OAUTH
settings.description: Visitor Google sign-ins per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_VISITOR_AUTH
settings.description: Visitor email-code sign-ins per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_VISITOR
settings.description: Finishing a visitor sign-in and signing out, per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_HANDLE_CHECK
settings.description: Address availability checks while someone types a handle (GET /v1/handles/check), per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_OAUTH_REGISTER
settings.description: AI app registrations on the connector, per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_OAUTH_AUTHORIZE
settings.description: AI app sign-in requests on the connector, per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_OAUTH_TOKEN
settings.description: AI app token requests on the connector, per address.

settings.name: ADMIN_API_KEY
settings.description: The admin's key. install.sh generates it and shows it once.

settings.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: Google sign-in for owners and visitors: the OAuth client ID. Set with the secret, or neither.

settings.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: Google sign-in: the OAuth client secret.

settings.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: An optional second visitor sign-in provider: its OAuth client ID. Set with the secret, or neither.

settings.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: The second provider's OAuth client secret.

settings.name: REVIEW_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
settings.description: A plugin reviewer's account that may sign in with a password on the connector. Set with the hash, or neither.

settings.name: REVIEW_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_HASH
settings.description: That reviewer account's password hash.

settings.name: MAX_SITES_PER_ACCOUNT
settings.description: Sites one account may hold (sites in Recently deleted count).

settings.name: MAX_SITES_OVERRIDES
settings.description: Accounts that may hold a different number of sites than MAX_SITES_PER_ACCOUNT: comma-separated <handle>:<sites>, e.g. chhotabreak:2000 (1 to 100000 each). It follows the handle: an account that changes its handle keeps its override under the old one.

settings.name: MAX_ARCHIVE_MB_OVERRIDES
settings.description: Accounts whose sites may be a different size than MAX_ARCHIVE_MB: comma-separated <handle>:<MB>, e.g. jot-transcribe:300 (1 to 500 each). It applies to new deploys only (a larger site already live stays up) and follows the handle like MAX_SITES_OVERRIDES. A proxy in front must accept bodies this large (4/3 of it for JSON and connector deploys), and the connector takes messages that large from every account, so keep values modest.

settings.name: MAX_FILES_PER_SITE
settings.description: Files in one upload. It can only be lowered.

settings.name: PREVIEW_LINK_TTL_MINUTES
settings.description: How long a preview link to a stored version works.

settings.name: EXPORT_LINK_TTL_MINUTES
settings.description: How long a site download link works (it holds private lists too).

settings.name: SITE_PASSCODES
settings.description: on lets owners put a passcode on a site (it needs PASSCODE_ENC_KEY and a per-site address). off refuses new ones; sites that already have one keep asking for it.

settings.name: PASSCODE_MIN_LENGTH
settings.description: Shortest passcode an owner may set, in characters. Any characters count; digits only is fine.

settings.name: PASSCODE_LOCKOUT_MINUTES
settings.description: How long one address is refused on a site once it has used up RATE_LIMIT_PASSCODE_IP.

settings.name: PASSCODE_SITE_LOCKOUT_MINUTES
settings.description: How long a site refuses every passcode try once RATE_LIMIT_PASSCODE_SITE is used up (visitors already let in are not affected).

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_UPLOAD
settings.description: Uploads and deploys per client.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_SITE_OPS
settings.description: Deleting, changing and restoring sites, and admin sign-in tries, per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_EXPORT
settings.description: Site and account downloads per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_ANALYTICS
settings.description: Top pages and referring domains reads, per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_PASSCODE_IP
settings.description: Wrong passcode tries on one site per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_PASSCODE_SITE
settings.description: Wrong passcode tries on one site from everyone together.

settings.name: MAX_ARCHIVE_MB
settings.description: Largest upload, and the size one site may have.

settings.name: KEEP_VERSIONS
settings.description: Deploys kept per site; 0 keeps all. install.sh sets 1, which means no rollback.

settings.name: PASSCODE_ENC_KEY
settings.description: Key that seals site passcodes (32 random bytes, base64: openssl rand -base64 32). Unset: no site can get a passcode. Changing it makes every stored passcode unreadable and signs every visitor out; owners then set new ones.

settings.name: PREVIEW_ACCOUNTS
settings.description: Accounts (comma-separated) whose sites expire on their own.

settings.name: PREVIEW_TTL_HOURS
settings.description: How long those accounts' sites last.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_STATE
settings.description: Saved-data and list writes per client.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_UNDO_DAYS
settings.description: How long every change to saved data, and every deleted list item, can be restored.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_HISTORY_MAX_MB
settings.description: A site's saved-data history above this is thinned, oldest first.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_SITE_MAX_MB
settings.description: Largest a site's live saved data may grow.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_SNAPSHOT_EVERY
settings.description: History keeps a full copy of a site's data at least this often.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_SWEEP_MINUTES
settings.description: How often expired history and deleted items are removed.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_WATCH_DAYS
settings.description: The window the admin page's saved-data watch reports.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_WATCH_INC_MAX
settings.description: A visitor increment larger than this counts as large in the watch.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_WATCH_ITEM_KB
settings.description: A list item larger than this counts as large in the watch.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_WATCH_KEEP_DAYS
settings.description: Watch counts older than this are removed.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_IDEMPOTENCY_HOURS
settings.description: How long a retried write gets its first answer back instead of applying twice.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_IDEMPOTENCY_MAX_PER_SITE
settings.description: Retry keys remembered per site; the oldest past this are dropped.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_READ_PER_SEC
settings.description: Saved-data reads per second per site and address.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_READ_BURST
settings.description: Saved-data reads allowed at once above that rate.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_APPEND_PER_MIN
settings.description: List items one address may add per minute without the owner's key.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_APPEND_BURST
settings.description: List items allowed at once above that rate.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_CONTENT_MAX_KB
settings.description: Largest one Page info document may be.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_CONTENT_NAMES_MAX
settings.description: Page info names one site may declare.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_ENTRY_MAX_KB
settings.description: Largest one new Submissions entry may be.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_ENTRIES_MAX
settings.description: Live entries one Submissions name may hold.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_WITHDRAW_UNDO_MINUTES
settings.description: How long a visitor can bring back an entry they withdrew.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_NOTIFY_EACH_MINUTES
settings.description: "Email me: each" sends at most one email per name this often, listing what arrived.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_NOTIFY_DAILY_HOURS
settings.description: "Email me: daily" sends at most one digest per name this often.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_SAVERS_MAX
settings.description: Emails and domains in one site's who-may-save and block lists together.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_ENTRIES_NAMES_MAX
settings.description: Submissions names one site may declare.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_PERSONAL_MAX_KB
settings.description: Largest one person's record in one Personal name may be.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_PERSONAL_NAMES_MAX
settings.description: Personal names one site may declare.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_BOARD_ITEM_MAX_KB
settings.description: Largest one Shared board item may be.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_BOARD_MAX
settings.description: Live items one Shared board may hold.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_BOARD_NAMES_MAX
settings.description: Shared board names one site may declare.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_PERSONAL_PEOPLE_MAX
settings.description: People who may hold a record in one Personal name.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_BOARD_WRITES_PER_MIN
settings.description: Shared board adds, changes and deletes one signed-in person may make per minute, on top of the per-address rate.

settings.name: SAVED_DATA_DEFAULT_KIND
settings.description: What a name no one declared is on a site made after the kinds. shared: anyone reads it and signed-in visitors save to it. declare_first: it takes no saves until the owner declares it. Older sites are shared either way.

settings.name: WRITE_AUTH_MODE
settings.description: on: page saves need a signed-in visitor or the owner's key. log: allowed, and logged.

settings.name: DOMAIN_UNPROVEN_HOURS
settings.description: A connected domain whose DNS never points here is released after this long.

settings.name: DOMAIN_UNPROVEN_MAX_DAYS
settings.description: A domain that points here but never goes live over HTTPS is released after this long.

settings.name: DOMAIN_LAPSE_WARN_HOURS
settings.description: A live domain failing every check: its owner is emailed after this long.

settings.name: DOMAIN_LAPSE_HOURS
settings.description: ... and it stops being the site's address after this long. Longer than DOMAIN_LAPSE_WARN_HOURS.

settings.name: DOMAIN_CHECK_INTERVAL_MINUTES
settings.description: How often connected domains are checked.

settings.name: DOMAIN_CERTS_PER_ACCOUNT_DAILY
settings.description: New custom-domain certificates one account may ask for in a day.

settings.name: EVENT_TTL_DAYS
settings.description: How long a claimed event hostname lives (only where EVENT_DNS_TOKEN is set).

settings.name: EVENT_MAX_CLAIMS
settings.description: Event hostnames one account may hold at once.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILIES
settings.description: on lets an account connect *.<its domain> once, so every site of the account answers at <site>.<its domain> (an address family). Families also need ADDRESS_FAMILY_CERT_DIR and a wildcard certificate the operator sets up.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILIES_PER_ACCOUNT
settings.description: Address families one account may connect. 0: none.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_UNPROVEN_HOURS
settings.description: How long a new address family may wait for its DNS records before it is dropped.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_LAPSE_WARN_HOURS
settings.description: How long a working address family may fail its checks before its owner is emailed.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_LAPSE_HOURS
settings.description: How long a working address family may fail its checks before it is disconnected. Must be longer than ADDRESS_FAMILY_LAPSE_WARN_HOURS.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_CHECK_INTERVAL_MINUTES
settings.description: How often address families are checked.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_ACTIVE_RECHECK_MINUTES
settings.description: How often a working address family's DNS records are proved again.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_CERTS_PER_ACCOUNT_DAILY
settings.description: Per-site-name certificates one account's families may ask for in a day (for a later release; wildcard families need none).

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_RESERVED_LABELS
settings.description: Names (comma-separated) that never name a site under an address family.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_CACHE_SECONDS
settings.description: How long the server keeps its list of working address families before reading it again.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_TLS_ASK
settings.description: Certificate checks (/internal/tls-ask), per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_DOMAIN_CHECK
settings.description: "Check again" on a domain, per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_DOMAIN_CHECK_USER
settings.description: "Check again" on a domain, per account.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_ADDRESS_FAMILY_CHECK
settings.description: "Check again" on an address family, per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_ADDRESS_FAMILY_CHECK_USER
settings.description: "Check again" on an address family, per account.

settings.name: CNAME_TARGET
settings.description: The hostname people point their own domain at with a CNAME record.

settings.name: CUSTOM_DOMAIN_IP
settings.description: This server's public IPv4, given as the A record for a bare domain (brand.com).

settings.name: SITE_CERT_DIR
settings.description: Where per-person certificates are requested from, and found ready from, the certificate issuer.

settings.name: SITE_BASE_CERT_DIR
settings.description: Like SITE_CERT_DIR, for the per-person certificates under SITE_BASE_DOMAIN. Required, with ready/ and requests/ in it, once SITE_BASE_MOVE is on with its own domain: the server will not start without it.

settings.name: DOMAIN_CERT_DIR
settings.description: Where custom-domain certificates are requested from the certificate issuer. Empty: issued by hand.

settings.name: ADDRESS_FAMILY_CERT_DIR
settings.description: Where address-family requests go to the family issuer, and where it says a family is served (ready/). Empty: no address family is ever served.

settings.name: EVENT_DNS_TOKEN
settings.description: The DNS token that hands out event hostnames. The public instance only.

settings.name: EVENT_DNS_TEAM_ID
settings.description: The DNS account the event token belongs to.

settings.name: EVENT_DOMAINS
settings.description: Zones (comma-separated) event hostnames are handed out under.

settings.name: EVENT_CREATE_PER_DAY
settings.description: Hosted events (EVENTS=hosted): events one account may create in a rolling day.

settings.name: EVENT_MAX_ACTIVE_PER_ORGANISER
settings.description: Hosted events: events one account may run at once (every stage but archived).

settings.name: EVENT_TEAM_SIZE_DEFAULT
settings.description: Hosted events: the team size cap a new event starts with; the organiser changes it.

settings.name: EVENT_SITES_KEEP_DAYS
settings.description: Hosted events: how long team sites stay up after an event closes, before they are removed (the organiser is warned by email first). The event page and results stay.

settings.name: HACK_INSTANCE_BUDGET_GB
settings.description: Hosted events: disk the whole instance may use for team sites; new events are refused above 80% of it. 0: no budget.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_EVENT_CODES_IP
settings.description: Hosted events: join, judge and team-code lookups and joins, per network address (roomy: a whole venue can share one address).

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_EVENT_CODES_USER
settings.description: Hosted events: join, judge and team-code joins and lookups, per account.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_EVENT_NAMES_USER
settings.description: Hosted events: event address checks while someone types one, per account.

settings.name: EVENTS
settings.description: hosted runs this server as a hosted hackathon platform (simple-hack.app): anyone signed in creates an event with its own page at <event>.<SITE_DOMAIN>, and accounts own no personal sites.

settings.name: EVENT_NAME_PEER
settings.description: The loopback address (http://127.0.0.1:<port>) of the other server handing out names under the same zone; each asks the other before taking a name. Used with EVENTS=hosted, or with EVENT_DNS_TOKEN (self-host claims); ignored otherwise.

settings.name: IDLE_EXEMPT_FAMILY_SITES
settings.description: on: a site whose main address is an address family is never removed as idle, like one with its own domain.

settings.name: DELETED_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long a deleted site stays restorable in Recently deleted.

settings.name: IDLE_AFTER_DAYS
settings.description: Idle cleanup: a site unused this long gets its owner a warning email.

settings.name: IDLE_GRACE_DAYS
settings.description: Idle cleanup: how long after the warning an unused site moves to Recently deleted.

settings.name: ANALYTICS_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long visit analytics are kept.

settings.name: API_METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long the admin page's API-call counts and shortened caller addresses are kept.

settings.name: API_GROWTH_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long the admin page's API growth counts (calls per day by country and by kind, no addresses) are kept. Keep at least 183 for the 6-month view.

settings.name: IDLE_CLEANUP
settings.description: on warns owners of long-unused sites, then moves them to Recently deleted.

settings.name: IDLE_CLEANUP_MAX_EMAILS
settings.description: Idle-cleanup emails one run sends.

settings.name: IDLE_CLEANUP_EXEMPT_HANDLES
settings.description: Accounts (comma-separated handles) whose sites the idle cleanup never touches. An account that later changes its handle stays exempt under the old one.

settings.name: IDLE_REPLY_TO
settings.description: Reply-To address of the idle-cleanup emails.

settings.name: RESEND_API_KEY
settings.description: A Resend API key for sending email (sign-in codes, alerts). Without it, email sign-in is off.

settings.name: MAIL_FROM
settings.description: The sender of every email, on a domain verified with Resend.

settings.name: AI_MAX_JOBS_PER_USER
settings.description: AI create: builds one person may run at once.

settings.name: AI_MAX_JOBS
settings.description: AI create: builds running at once on the whole server.

settings.name: AI_JOB_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
settings.description: AI create: how long one build may run.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_AI_IP
settings.description: AI create requests per address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_AI_USER
settings.description: AI create requests per account.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_TRANSCRIBE
settings.description: Voice input requests, per address and per account.

settings.name: ASK_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether the "Ask about this page" box is shown (it also needs a model backend).

settings.name: ASK_BURST
settings.description: Ask: questions one address may ask at once.

settings.name: ASK_EVERY_SECONDS
settings.description: Ask: then one more question every this many seconds, per address.

settings.name: ASK_DAILY_MAX
settings.description: Ask: questions answered per day across everyone. 0 answers none.

settings.name: ASK_MAX_IN_FLIGHT
settings.description: Ask: questions answered at once on the whole server.

settings.name: ASK_MODEL
settings.description: Ask: the model the box asks, through the same backend as AI create.

settings.name: ASK_REASONING_EFFORT
settings.description: Ask: how long the model thinks before answering. none answers in seconds.

settings.name: ASK_MAX_TOKENS
settings.description: Ask: longest answer, in tokens.

settings.name: SETUP_CHECK_DAILY_MAX
settings.description: The setup helper's optional "Check my choices": checks answered per day across everyone, through the Ask model. 0 turns it off.

settings.name: SETUP_CHECK_MAX_IN_FLIGHT
settings.description: The setup helper's check: checks answered at once on the whole server, apart from Ask's own.

settings.name: SETUP_CHECK_PER_NETWORK_DAILY
settings.description: The setup helper's check: checks one network (a /24, or a /48 for IPv6) may run per day.

settings.name: SETUP_ASSIST_DAILY_MAX
settings.description: The setup helper's assistant: messages answered per day across everyone, through the Ask model. 0 turns it off and hides its panel.

settings.name: SETUP_ASSIST_MAX_IN_FLIGHT
settings.description: The setup helper's assistant: messages answered at once on the whole server, apart from Ask's and the check's.

settings.name: SETUP_ASSIST_PER_NETWORK_DAILY
settings.description: The setup helper's assistant: messages one network (a /24, or a /48 for IPv6) may send per day.

settings.name: LLM_PROVIDER
settings.description: The model backend for AI create and Ask.

settings.name: LLM_API_KEY
settings.description: The model backend's key. Ask and AI create run only with a backend set.

settings.name: LLM_BASE_URL
settings.description: The backend's address; wins over the provider's.

settings.name: LLM_MODEL
settings.description: The model AI create uses; wins over the provider's.

settings.name: VISION_PROVIDER
settings.description: AI create: the backend that reads attached images.

settings.name: VISION_API_KEY
settings.description: AI create: the image backend's key.

settings.name: VISION_BASE_URL
settings.description: AI create: the image backend's address.

settings.name: VISION_MODEL
settings.description: AI create: the image model.

settings.name: TRANSCRIBE_URL
settings.description: A speech-to-text service on this server for voice input. Unset: no microphone button.

settings.name: TRANSCRIBE_TICKET_SECRET
settings.description: Shared with the speech service for live transcription.

settings.name: DB_DSN
settings.description: The Postgres connection string. install.sh sets it for the bundled database.

settings.name: DATA_DIR
settings.description: The folder that holds every site's files and versions.

settings.name: ANALYTICS_PAGES_PER_SITE_DAY
settings.description: Distinct pages a site's Top pages keeps per day; views of further new pages that day are counted together as (other).

settings.name: ANALYTICS_REFERRERS_PER_SITE_DAY
settings.description: Distinct referring domains a site keeps per day; further new domains that day are counted together as (other).

settings.name: NETWORK_MONTHLY_ALLOWANCE_GB
settings.description: The box's free outbound data a month, in GB (1 TB = 1024 GB), which the admin page's network bar measures this month's outbound against. 10240 is Oracle Cloud Always Free's 10 TB. 0 hides the bar.

settings.name: NETWORK_ALERT_PCT
settings.description: The share of NETWORK_MONTHLY_ALLOWANCE_GB at which the admin page's network bar turns amber, and the box's daily watch script sends its one alert of the month.

settings.name: NETWORK_SAMPLE_MINUTES
settings.description: How often the box's network counters are added to the month's totals. The admin page adds the growth since the last sample itself, so this only bounds what a reboot can lose.

settings.name: API_METRICS_FLUSH_SECONDS
settings.description: How often counted API calls are written to the database for the admin page's API traffic and growth. Calls counted since the last write are lost if the server stops abruptly.

settings.name: ANALYTICS_LOG
settings.description: The web server's access log that visit analytics are read from. Empty: no analytics.

settings.name: ANALYTICS_SALT
settings.description: Salt for the hashed visitor addresses in analytics. Empty: derived from ADMIN_API_KEY.

settings.name: NETWORK_INTERFACE
settings.description: The network interface whose traffic the admin page reports as the box's own. Empty: the one the default route leaves by. Inside a container, where that is the container's own, network use is off unless this is set.

settings.name: GEOIP_DIR
settings.description: Where the local location databases are. Missing files mean blank locations, never a lookup elsewhere.
